pos.personaBrief: Wenger wanted a team that builds and takes risks (2002 stated view) and moved to 4-5-1 possession in 2005-06, but his 1997-2004 sides and the 2014-16 plan were fast counter-attackers, so possession is preferred rather than dogma.

pro.personaBrief: Bergkamp-era build-up from the back ('heart of the defence beat to the same pulse', quick accurate passes) but with fast transitions after winning the ball (Football Faithful, Left-Sided Problem).

est.personaBrief: Bergkamp: Wenger thinks in players and lets them determine the system; Invincibles were an extremely fluid 4-4-2 with interchanging positions and Bergkamp dropping.

lar.personaBrief: Invincibles used Henry drifting left, wingers cutting inside and attacking full-backs; later Hard Tackle describes wide forwards roaming inside, so play is central-combinational with full-backs providing width.

blo.personaBrief: Invincibles pressed moderately with Henry and Bergkamp closing centre-backs; the trap and high line, later a deeper block in 2012-16, mean pressing is partial and not extreme.

mar.personaBrief: Set-piece policy was man-for-man until 2011 (football.co.uk 2009), then zonal trial; in open play a zonal back four with offside trap, and he says no system is ideal.

pla.personaBrief: Stated view: 'we just play to our strengths' and play a style we think is right; though he shaped the system to his players, his own identity prevailed over opponent adaptation, with exceptions in 2014-16 big games.

res.personaBrief: Style-first philosophy ('a team that expresses itself, that builds, that takes risks'), values and entertainment; he did not shut games down.

sis.personaBrief: Bergkamp: he thinks in terms of intelligent players and lets them decide the system; stars like Henry and Bergkamp had freedom, though he was not a strict disciplinarian.

jog.personaBrief: Technique and intelligence led (Bergkamp, Fabregas, Cazorla, Ozil), but Vieira, Campbell and the pace of the Invincibles show physical intensity is required.

bas.personaBrief: Promoting from within is a club value, with Fabregas, Wilshere and austerity-era academy focus, but Arsenal also signed experienced and foreign stars, and won with mixed ages.

lid.personaBrief: Parlour and Adams: not a disciplinarian, never liked confrontation; he consulted players (Hateley), speaks of respect and meeting needs, and treats club values as authority.
